title: FunCore
description: An essentials + fun Minecraft plugin with staff tools, ranks, vanish, profiles, and moderation commands.
body:
# FunCore

FunCore is a powerful all-in-one Minecraft server core plugin that combines essential moderation tools with fun features for players. Designed for modern servers running **Paper** on Minecraft **1.21+**, FunCore provides server owners with a flexible system for managing staff, players, ranks, and chat — all in one plugin.

## Key Features

• Moderation System  
Includes powerful moderation commands such as `/!ban` and `/!kick` with customizable punishment messages and optional staff notes.

• Staff Tools  
Advanced `/!vanish` and `/!staffmode` features allow staff members to moderate players invisibly, monitor activity, and access special staff utilities.

• Rank Management System  
Create and manage server ranks directly in-game. Assign ranks to players and customize chat tags and permissions.

• Player Profiles  
Use `/!profile` to view player statistics and server information.

• Chat Management  
Includes chat moderation tools like announcements, chat locking, and configurable welcome messages.

• Fun Commands  
Adds entertaining commands like `/!dance` to keep gameplay fun for your community.

• Consistent Command System  
All commands use the `/!` prefix so players easily know they belong to FunCore.

## Example Commands

/!vanish  
/!staffmode  
/!ban  
/!kick  
/!announce  
/!report  
/!profile  
/!dance

## Compatibility

FunCore currently supports:

• Paper servers  
• Minecraft **1.21+**

Spigot support may be added in a future update.
